answer_1.quote: Visual captioning serves as a foundation for image/video understanding tools ... We use the Microsoft COCO validation set, Flickr 8K, Pascal-50S and Composite datasets for evaluation of captioning systems.

answer_2.quote: We benchmark our proposed caption evaluation metrics against the rule-based metrics used in the Microsoft COCO 2015 Captioning Competition ... SMURF and BERTScore demonstrate the highest correlation with human judgment in this dataset.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluations of competition entries were collected using Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT). Participants were asked to rate how natural the corrected sentences sounded ... M1 (percentage better than or equal to human description) and M2 (percentage passing the Turing Test) were derived as ground truth to rank competitors.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators answered questions about whether a caption is better than or equal to a human description (M1) and whether it passes the Turing Test (M2), as well as expert ratings of correctness and detail.
criteria: M1: percentage better than or equal to human description
M2: percentage passing the Turing Test
